typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	sFileName as string (),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		WFSENTRYDATE as date,
		EQDWMSGID as string,
		WFSDBMSGID as string,
		WFSSYSTEMID as string,
		WFSDESKID as string,
		WFSMSGTYPE as string,
		AVGPX_6 as float,
		CLORDID_11 as string,
		COMMISSION_12 as string,
		COMMTYPE_13 as string,
		CURRENCY_15 as string,
		SECURITYIDSOURCE_22 as string,
		LASTMKT_30 as string,
		MSGSEQNUM_34 as string,
		ORDERID_37 as string,
		SECURITYID_48 as string,
		SENDERCOMPID_49 as string,
		SENDERSUBID_50 as string,
		SENDINGTIME_52 as string,
		QUANTITY_53 as float,
		SIDE_54 as string,
		SYMBOL_55 as string,
		TARGETCOMPID_56 as string,
		TEXT_58 as string,
		TRANSACTTIME_60 as string,
		SETTLTYPE_63 as string,
		SETTLDATE_64 as date,
		ALLOCID_70 as string,
		ALLOCTRANSTYPE_71 as string,
		REFALLOCID_72 as string,
		NOORDERS_73 as string,
		TRADEDATE_75 as date,
		NOALLOCS_78 as string,
		ALLOCACCOUNT_79 as string,
		POSSRESEND_97 as string,
		CLIENTID_109 as string,
		SETTLCURRENCY_120 as string,
		SETTLCURRFXRATE_155 as string,
		SETTLCURRFXRATECALC_156 as string,
		SECURITYEXCHANGE_207 as string,
		GROSSTRADEAMT_381 as float,
		FIDESSATRADEFLAGS_6450 as string,
		ERRCOUNT as string,
		CREATEDTMSTP as timestamp,
		CREATEDUSER as string,
		LASTMODIFIEDTMSTP as string,
		LASTMODIFIEDUSER as string,
		VOLUMEDONE_80 as float
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource1
FlatFileSource1 derive(FileName = toString(($sFileName))) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive({Copy of FileName} = FileName) ~> DataConversion
DerivedColumn aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
DataConversion sink(input(
		ALLOCACCOUNT_79 as string,
		MSGSEQNUM_34 as string,
		WFSSYSTEMID as string,
		SETTLDATE_64 as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		REFALLOCID_72 as string,
		SENDINGTIME_52 as string,
		CREATEDTMSTP as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CLIENTID_109 as string,
		SIDE_54 as string,
		GROSSTRADEAMT_381 as float,
		SETTLCURRENCY_120 as string,
		SENDERCOMPID_49 as string,
		ORDERID_37 as string,
		SECURITYID_48 as string,
		WFSMSGTYPE as string,
		TRADEDATE_75 as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		WFSDESKID as string,
		TARGETCOMPID_56 as string,
		LASTMKT_30 as string,
		AVGPX_6 as float,
		SECURITYIDSOURCE_22 as string,
		TEXT_58 as string,
		CREATEDUSER as string,
		VOLUMEDONE_80 as float,
		WFSDBMSGID as string,
		COMMISSION_12 as string,
		ALLOCTRANSTYPE_71 as string,
		TRANSACTTIME_60 as string,
		POSSRESEND_97 as string,
		FileName as string,
		NOALLOCS_78 as string,
		WFSENTRYDATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CURRENCY_15 as string,
		SENDERSUBID_50 as string,
		SECURITYEXCHANGE_207 as string,
		ALLOCID_70 as string,
		LASTMODIFIEDTMSTP as string,
		LASTMODIFIEDUSER as string,
		EQDWMSGID as string,
		SETTLCURRFXRATE_155 as string,
		SYMBOL_55 as string,
		NOORDERS_73 as string,
		QUANTITY_53 as float,
		ERRCOUNT as string,
		COMMTYPE_13 as string,
		SETTLTYPE_63 as string,
		SETTLCURRFXRATECALC_156 as string,
		FIDESSATRADEFLAGS_6450 as string,
		CLORDID_11 as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		ALLOCACCOUNT_79,
		MSGSEQNUM_34,
		WFSSYSTEMID,
		SETTLDATE_64,
		REFALLOCID_72,
		SENDINGTIME_52,
		CREATEDTMSTP,
		CLIENTID_109,
		SIDE_54,
		GROSSTRADEAMT_381,
		SETTLCURRENCY_120,
		SENDERCOMPID_49,
		ORDERID_37,
		SECURITYID_48,
		WFSMSGTYPE,
		TRADEDATE_75,
		WFSDESKID,
		TARGETCOMPID_56,
		LASTMKT_30,
		AVGPX_6,
		SECURITYIDSOURCE_22,
		TEXT_58,
		CREATEDUSER,
		VOLUMEDONE_80,
		WFSDBMSGID,
		COMMISSION_12,
		ALLOCTRANSTYPE_71,
		TRANSACTTIME_60,
		POSSRESEND_97,
		FileName = {Copy of FileName},
		NOALLOCS_78,
		WFSENTRYDATE,
		CURRENCY_15,
		SENDERSUBID_50,
		SECURITYEXCHANGE_207,
		ALLOCID_70,
		LASTMODIFIEDTMSTP,
		LASTMODIFIEDUSER,
		EQDWMSGID,
		SETTLCURRFXRATE_155,
		SYMBOL_55,
		NOORDERS_73,
		QUANTITY_53,
		ERRCOUNT,
		COMMTYPE_13,
		SETTLTYPE_63,
		SETTLCURRFXRATECALC_156,
		FIDESSATRADEFLAGS_6450,
		CLORDID_11),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
